trust_decision.summary: Whether a favicon URL's host resolves only to public IPs is decided by a separate DNS lookup in IsValidUri, before HttpClient connects and resolves the host again on its own (check-then-use on the DNS answer).

landing_point.why: The summary names favicon extraction and DNS, and IsValidUri is the only DNS-based private-IP check in the extractor. A search for 'favicon' leads straight to this file.

fix_sites.entry_point: same entry points, reached through the <link rel=icon> href parsed from the fetched HTML (TryExtractFaviconFromNodes)
same entry points, reached through a redirect Location header (FollowRedirectsAsync)
CreateHttpClient, used by every fetch above; the fix moves the IP check into a SocketsHttpHandler ConnectCallback
IsValidUri reduced to a scheme and port check
GetFaviconAsync gains a catch for HttpRequestException thrown by the connect callback

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All fix sites are in apps/server/Utilities/AliasVault.FaviconExtractor/FaviconExtractor.cs. No other server-side HTTP fetcher exists at the pinned commit; other HttpClient users are in the Blazor WASM client (apps/server/AliasVault.Client), which runs in the browser.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could argue the redirect hop (FaviconExtractor.cs:527) and the HTML-supplied icon href (FaviconExtractor.cs:323) are already 'validated' because they call IsValidUri, and patch only the initial check at :91. All three still share the same pre-resolve TOCTOU.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Normal favicon fetches from public hosts, including redirects (up to 5), cookie-wall retries (2 attempts) and hosts with several public A/AAAA records, must keep working. A fix that blocks all redirects, or rejects any multi-address answer, breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: hostname that resolves to a public IP at check time and a private IP at connect time (rebinding)
DNS answer mixing public and private addresses (fix.diff:499-505)
IP literal host (fix routes through Dns.GetHostAddressesAsync in the connect callback, fix.diff:608)
HTML <link rel=icon> href, absolute or relative (fix.diff:635)
single URL vs batch of up to 10 URLs (apps/server/AliasVault.Api/Controllers/FaviconController.cs:33, apps/server/AliasVault.Api/Controllers/FaviconController.cs:102)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second client factory (e.g. a plain HttpClientHandler client for the favicon-image download step, separate from the page client) that keeps the old resolve-then-connect check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The page fetch and the image fetch already sit in different methods (:226 vs :318), and splitting clients by Accept headers or timeouts is a common refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A neighbouring server-side 'fetch site metadata/title' or logo endpoint in another project that copies IsValidUri plus a default HttpClient.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Password managers often fetch page titles next to icons, and a maintainer would reuse the old validator verbatim. This puts a second implementation in another package, at a distance from the landing point.

O9_family: SSRF via TOCTOU DNS rebinding (check-then-connect on hostname resolution)

O10_build.project_tests: apps/server/Tests/AliasVault.UnitTests/Utilities/FaviconExtractorTests.cs (positive test fetches adsense.google.com over the internet; block tests use literal private IPs and localhost)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Resolve the host in IsValidUri, then rewrite the request URI to the vetted IP literal (breaks TLS SNI and Host for HTTPS), or keep the separate pre-check and add a second lookup, which leaves the race open.

out_of_scope_notes: IPAddressValidator (apps/server/Utilities/AliasVault.FaviconExtractor/IPAddressValidator.cs:22-46) does not list some ranges (e.g. NAT64 64:ff9b::/96, 6to4 2002::/16 embedding private v4); this is a range-completeness issue, not this advisory's TOCTOU.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check run); the monorepo includes mobile, extension, Rust core and docs, so it is likely well over 5 MB.

needs_network_at_runtime: blocking can be exercised offline with a local stub DNS resolver, but the must-keep-working fetch needs a host that resolves to a public IP. The existing positive test uses the live internet (apps/server/Tests/AliasVault.UnitTests/Utilities/FaviconExtractorTests.cs:22). A hidden test harness would need DNS/socket injection to stay offline.

Proxy subtlety: HttpClientHandler/SocketsHttpHandler honour system proxy env vars by default. With a proxy, a ConnectCallback sees the proxy endpoint, not the target. Not checked whether deployments set HTTP(S)_PROXY.
Advisory text itself not available; trust decision derived from the fix diff and commit title only.
present_in_latest not applicable (no O8 routes; latest release: none).
